### view=anytime includeCompleted=false filters=none
ARGS: []interface {}(nil)

SELECT
	t.uuid,
	COALESCE(t.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.notes, ''),
	COALESCE(t.type, 0),
	COALESCE(t.status, 0),
	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 1 AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

SELECT
	t.uuid,
	COALESCE(t.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.notes, ''),
	COALESCE(t.type, 0),
	COALESCE(t.status, 0),
	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 1 AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (p.uuid = ? OR p.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),

LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 1 AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

ESCAPE '\') AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.startDate >= ? AND t.startDate <= ? GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

### view=anytime includeCompleted=true filters=none
ARGS: []interface {}(nil)

SELECT
	t.uuid,
	COALESCE(t.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.notes, ''),
	COALESCE(t.type, 0),
	COALESCE(t.status, 0),
	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 1 AND (t.status = 0 OR (t.status IN (2, 3) AND COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0) > COALESCE((SELECT manualLogDate FROM TMSettings LIMIT 1), 0) AND date(COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') = date('now', 'localtime') AND NOT (COALESCE(p.status, 0) IN (2, 3)))) AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 1 AND (t.status = 0 OR (t.status IN (2, 3) AND COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0) > COALESCE((SELECT manualLogDate FROM TMSettings LIMIT 1), 0) AND date(COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') = date('now', 'localtime') AND NOT (COALESCE(p.status, 0) IN (2, 3)))) AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND t.deadline = ? GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t.deadline ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

SELECT
	t.uuid,
	COALESCE(t.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.notes, ''),
	COALESCE(t.type, 0),
	COALESCE(t.status, 0),
	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (p.uuid = ? OR p.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t.deadline ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (p.uuid = ? OR p.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t.deadline ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

### view=inbox includeCompleted=true filters=area

SELECT
	t.uuid,
	COALESCE(t.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.notes, ''),
	COALESCE(t.type, 0),
	COALESCE(t.status, 0),
	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

### view=inbox includeCompleted=true filters=tag
ARGS: []interface {}{"urgent"}

SELECT
	t.uuid,
	COALESCE(t.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.notes, ''),
	COALESCE(t.type, 0),
	COALESCE(t.status, 0),
	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),

	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),

	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),

LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (p.uuid = ? OR p.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

### view=logbook includeCompleted=false filters=none
ARGS: []interface {}(nil)

SELECT
	t.uuid,
	COALESCE(t.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.notes, ''),
	COALESCE(t.type, 0),
	COALESCE(t.status, 0),
	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.status IN (2, 3) AND t.trashed = 0 AND COALESCE((((t.start = 1 AND t.startBucket IN (0, 1) AND t.startDate IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0) > COALESCE((SELECT manualLogDate FROM TMSettings LIMIT 1), 0) AND date(COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') = date('now', 'localtime')) OR (t.start = 1 AND t.type = 0 AND COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0) > COALESCE((SELECT manualLogDate FROM TMSettings LIMIT 1), 0) AND date(COALESCE(t.stopDate, 0), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') = date('now', 'localtime'))) AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL), 0) = 0 AND NOT (COALESCE(p.status, 0) IN (2, 3)) AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t.stopDate DESC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

FROM TMTask t

	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND t.startDate <= ? GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), COALESCE(p."index", 0), t.start ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	COALESCE(t.start, 0),
	COALESCE(t.startBucket, 0),
	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t

LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE ((COALESCE(p.status, 0) IN (2, 3) OR COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 1) OR t.status = 0) AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (p.uuid = ? OR p.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), COALESCE(p."index", 0), t.start ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE ((COALESCE(p.status, 0) IN (2, 3) OR COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 1) OR t.status = 0) AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND (p.uuid = ? OR p.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND (COALESCE(a.uuid, pa.uuid) = ? OR COALESCE(a.title, pa.title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND t.startDate >= ? AND t.startDate <= ? GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), COALESCE(p."index", 0), t.start ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t.uuid IN (SELECT tt2.tasks FROM TMTaskTag tt2 JOIN TMTag tg2 ON tt2.tags = tg2.uuid WHERE tg2.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t.type ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL AND t.area IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(a."index", pa."index", 0), CASE WHEN p.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(p."index", 0), t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC

	t.startDate,
	t.deadline,
	t.stopDate,
	t.creationDate,
	COALESCE(t.trashed, 0),
	COALESCE(p.uuid, ''),
	COALESCE(p.title, ''),
	COALESCE(t.heading, ''),
	COALESCE(h.title, ''),
	COALESCE(a.uuid, COALESCE(pa.uuid, '')),
	COALESCE(a.title, COALESCE(pa.title, '')),
	COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(tag.title, char(31)), ''),
	COALESCE(t."index", 0),
	COALESCE(t.todayIndex, 0),
	CASE WHEN t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM TMTask t
LEFT JOIN TMTask h ON t.heading = h.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTask p ON p.uuid = COALESCE(t.project, h.project)
LEFT JOIN TMArea a ON t.area = a.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMArea pa ON p.area = pa.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTaskTag tt ON tt.tasks = t.uuid
LEFT JOIN TMTag tag ON tt.tags = tag.uuid
 WHERE t.start = 2 AND t.startDate IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 0 AND t.trashed = 0 AND t.type IN (0, 1) AND COALESCE(p.trashed, 0) = 0 AND t."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL AND p."rt1_recurrenceRule" IS NULL GROUP BY t.uuid ORDER BY t.startDate ASC, t.todayIndex ASC, t."index" ASC, t.uuid ASC
